##### Project general facts

Lilac Park presents a distinctive collection of four-bedroom townhouses, each meticulously designed to elevate your living experience. The ground floor seamlessly integrates the living, dining, and family rooms, accompanied by a well-appointed kitchen, a spacious terrace, and parking spaces for two cars. The upper floors host four bedrooms with en-suite facilities, while an additional maid's room with a bathroom adds to the convenience. Each townhouse features a rooftop garden, providing a private oasis in the heart of Lilac Park, creating a harmonious blend of modern living and serene green spaces.

Adding a touch of greenery to urban living, each townhouse features a rooftop garden that serves as a private retreat. The thoughtful design ensures that residents enjoy both the comforts of modern living and the tranquility of outdoor spaces. The spacious terrace on the ground floor extends the living area outdoors, creating a perfect setting for relaxation and entertainment.

Every residence at Lilac Park features modern finishing with high-quality materials, fully equipped kitchens, and thoughtfully designed spaces that cater to contemporary family living. The interiors are crafted with attention to detail, creating homes that are both functional and elegant. From the spacious living areas to the well-appointed bedrooms, each space is designed to provide comfort and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, a vibrant and rapidly growing community in the heart of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. The idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood features tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments, creating a truly unique and welcoming place to call home.

The location is distinguished by its sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life while still being conveniently located within Dubai. Residents enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It is a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
